title: centrolepis tenuior
intro: Centrolepis tenuior, commonly known as the New Zealand wind-grass or native wind-grass, is a species of flowering plant in the family Centrolepidaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Centrolepis tenuior are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal activities. Additionally, the plant's bioactive constituents may also contribute to its potential therapeutic actions, including anti-diabetic, anti-cancer, and cardiovascular protective effects.
